ownership: PR20's original owner integrated reset review before PR19. Composition preserves that landed source, all eleven new owner tests and all owner evidence. No owner branch was modified.

resetFixture.meaning: The actual Reset/Keep and R/Escape controls retain exact watch/save facts, full comparison HTML and all selected alternative values. Explicit Start new watch performs the existing hidden-playfield reset assertions.

Physical-device and actual screen-reader acceptance remain separate.
